query: Please provide documentation and examples for developing fused custom AscendC operators for PyTorch, including project_json op definition, tiling data and host tiling functions, kernel_operator.h APIs for GEMM/MatMul and elementwise ops (BatchNorm, GELU, ReLU), and Python binding with aclnn and pytorch_npu_helper.
AscendC high-level APIs for GEMM/MatMul, BatchNorm (inference), GELU, ReLU and examples of fused custom operator registration (project.json, tiling, host operator, kernel, and PyTorch binding).
